claims.statement: Maintain margin guidance in the 18-20% band.
claims.quote: When you are saying that you will maintain the margin guidance of 18-20%.
claims.speaker: analyst

claims.statement: Open to taking more price increases in the first six months to compensate for cost deficits.
claims.quote: for the first six months, possibly yes, we are still open to more price increases we need to take from the current levels where we are, and that would really compensate for some deficit what we are seeing.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Expects the volume-value gap trajectory to remain around 3-4% as we go ahead.
claims.quote: we think that this trajectory of 3-4% will remain as we go ahead.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The VAE part of the VAM-VAE project is being commissioned in the first half.
facts.quote: the fact that what we are commissioning in this first half is only the VAE part, the entire VAM-VAE project as such will still take some time

facts.statement: Upstocking in the month of March resulted in higher growth rates by 3-4%.
facts.quote: The impact of that would be for the month of March, the March growth rates would be higher by 3-4% mark, which would be the impact of the upstocking which would have happened in the month of March.

facts.statement: Material component per square foot for the customer is only about 35-40%, with labour forming the larger area.
facts.quote: The material component in terms of the per square feet of what lands to the customer, is only about 35-40%. The larger area is of labour.
